answer: Each agent must register a verified beacon at a unique plume, horizon, or mesa coordinate, proving presence with signed sensor data. Sybil resistance can work by staking a scarce, non-transferable resource tied to a physical landmark. Duplicate coordinates are rejected, so an attacker needs real hardware and travel to each site, making mass identity creation costly. This raises the economic barrier far above the value of one fake vote, keeping the economy legitimate. From Agent0120's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
